description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Soraka''' creates a celestial zone at the target location that deals magic damage to enemy champions within at the time of cast. The zone then persists for 1.5 seconds and [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silences]] enemies within.
description.text: Active: Soraka creates a celestial zone at the target location that deals magic damage to enemy champions within at the time of cast. The zone then persists for 1.5 seconds and silences enemies within.

description2.raw: Afterwards, the zone erupts to deal the same damage to enemy champions within and [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|root]] them for a duration.
description2.text: Afterwards, the zone erupts to deal the same damage to enemy champions within and root them for a duration.

notes.raw: * ''Equinox's'' [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silence]] is marked as non-dispellable, so it is not removed by most [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleanses]]. It is however allowed to be removed by cleanses that '''also''' grant immunity to it, such as [[File:Olaf OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Olaf|An icon representing Olaf]] [[Olaf|Olaf's]] [[File:Olaf Ragnarok.png|20xpx|border|link=Olaf#Ragnarok|An icon for Olaf's ability Ragnarok]] [[Olaf#Ragnarok|Ragnarok]]. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will not block the [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silence]].
notes.text:
Equinox's silence is marked as non-dispellable, so it is not removed by most cleanses. It is however allowed to be removed by cleanses that also grant immunity to it, such as Olaf's Ragnarok.
Spell shield will not block the silence.
